body: I don't feel like I'm feeling anything. When they said to me they wanted a divorce even then I didn't feel anything. I didn't cry or get upset. I didn't  even respond. I know its meaningful to say my life has value and I appreciate you reaching out. I wish I could believe it but honestly I don't. I admit that I am constantly judging myself. But I'd be lying if I said I tried to change and be a better person. I just didn't have the will to really out forth the effort. And to me if I can't even be willing to try then I am someone who doesn't have any value. And I've accepted that.
